entities.name: Web Browser
entities.rationale: Web browser client used by users to access the PixelStrings platform.

entities.name: WEB SERVER / JOB MANAGER
entities.rationale: An EC2 instance that runs the web server front-end and the job manager.

entities.name: DATABASE
entities.rationale: Database storing cached clip metadata and job tracking information.

entities.name: IMF
entities.rationale: An EC2 instance running Interoperable Master Format wrapping processes.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket owned by the user to store input and output video clips.

entities.name: LAMBDA
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function used to fetch metadata from video clips in S3.

entities.name: G3
entities.rationale: GPU-accelerated EC2 instance cluster executing video retiming and editing workloads.

visual_connections.description: The user logs into the web server using their browser.
The web server reads and saves metadata information from/to the database.
The job manager invokes Lambda functions to retrieve file metadata.
Lambda accesses the S3 bucket to extract media metadata.
The job manager coordinates jobs on the GPU instances.
Processed video clips are written back to the user's S3 bucket.
